The '''1969–70 Scottish Division One''' was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] by twelve points over nearest rival [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]]. [[Raith Rovers F.C.|Raith Rovers]] and [[Partick Thistle F.C.|Partick Thistle]] finished 17th and 18th respectively and were relegated to the [[1970–71 Scottish Division Two|1970-71 Second Division]].
